description: This file defines hooks and handlers for managing Discord subagent sessions within a plugin system, including spawning, ending, and delivery targeting of subagents, with external dependencies on openclaw plugin SDK and internal modules.

methods.name: summarizeError
methods.description: Converts an unknown error object into a string message.

methods.name: normalizeThreadBindingTargetKind
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string into a ThreadBindingTargetKind or undefined.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingFlags
methods.description: Resolves thread binding configuration flags for a given account.

methods.name: handleDiscordSubagentSpawning
methods.description: Handles the spawning of a Discord subagent, including validation and binding.

methods.name: handleDiscordSubagentEnded
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a Discord subagent session ends.

methods.name: handleDiscordSubagentDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Determines the delivery target for a subagent message, returning origin info if applicable.

methods.name: registerDiscordSubagentHooks
methods.description: Registers event handlers for subagent lifecycle events.
